title: Assistance for Companies Considering Implementing Shorter Work Weeks
what_it_is: Assistance for Companies Considering Implementing Shorter Work Weeks

sections.label: Compressed work week arrangements
sections.summary: Compressed work week condenses a standard work week into fewer than five days with the same total hours, and about one in 10 establishments offered it in 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Compressed work week is one of several flexible work arrangements that employers may offer to their employees.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: A standard work week is condensed into fewer than five days; and employees complete their expected workload within a shorter work week, with the total number of hours worked remaining the same.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: In 2020, about one in 10 establishments offered compressed work week as a flexible work arrangement to their employees.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Companies can refer to the Tripartite Alliance for Fair and Progressive Employment Practices’ (TAFEP) website for more information and resources on how to implement compressed work week arrangements, including policy templates and case studies of companies that have successfully done so.

sections.label: Human Capital Partnership and procurement
sections.summary: The Human Capital Partnership recognises employers with about 600 companies, and tender specifications should remain objective with core KPIs and business requirements.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: Indeed, one example is the Human Capital Partnership (HCP) which recognises such employers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: Employers that are in HCP enjoy faster response and better service standards from a dedicated hotline that they can call and to get advice on schemes and grants from the Government to promote human capital development and also to support the companies in implementing flexible work arrangements.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: There are about 600 companies in the list right now and we do encourage more companies to be nominated to be part of this HCP.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: On the Member's suggestion that for tender specifications and Government procurement, for us to include this as a consideration, I think we will have to recognise that for tender specifications, it is important that we try to keep it as objective, to make sure that the basic fundamentals of KPI, work performances, business requirements, all these which are basic, remain core.
